text:
sarah: Heads up — ThirdEye Health's March invoice shows two platform_fee line items after their Private migration. Invoice: https://invoices.internal/INV-5678. Can someone confirm overlap? cc @clare

anita: I pulled the events — they migrated their workloads to Private on 2026-03-01 and we triggered the migration add-on charge the same day. Their billing cycle is 02/15 -> 03/14, so looks like a ~14-day overlap.

clare: Customer asked explicitly not to be double-billed; sales note says we should pro-rate the migration month. I have the email thread saved.

mike: Agree pro-rate. Quick invoice snippet: 
```
platform_fee  1,200.00  02/15 - 03/14
platform_fee  1,200.00  migration add-on 03/01
```
Propose credit = prorated overlap (14/30 * 1200) ~= $560. Need GL code to post. @luke for approval :pray:

luke: approve one-off credit for migration overlap. GL: 4-100-PlatformCredits. Add audit note: "migration overlap credit - ThirdEye Health".

sarah: I'll draft the credit memo once mike confirms amount. Mike — will this be a credit memo applied to INV-5678 or a refund?

mike: Will issue a credit memo and apply to INV-5678. Calculator: 14 days / 30 days * $1,200 = $560.00 (rounding to cents). Creating ADJ now.

billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-9921, amount: -560.00, status: pending approval.

raj: Legal quick check — do we have written confirmation/agreement to prorate? Need the email thread attached to the credit memo for audit.

clare: Yes — email thread titled "migration billing" from 2026-02-20 where we agreed to pro-rate. I'll attach to the credit memo after mike creates it.

mike: Done. Credit memo ADJ-9921 issued and applied to INV-5678. Amount: $560.00 credit. GL posted to 4-100-PlatformCredits. Memo link: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-9921. No refund issued.

sarah: :thumbsup: Closing loop. I'll update the monthly reconciliation and mark INV-5678 as adjusted. Thanks all!
